name: Survey tile in Aquarius
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.8 degrees south of the ecliptic in Aquarius, imaged by SPHEREx 16 times in 7 visits over 37 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 32 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 37 hours starting 2025-06-03, at wavelengths from 1.64 to 4.96 um. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
